subject: Quick Redwood walkthrough: use case, traffic, and timing
messages:
From: Alex Kim <alex.kim@cartology.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Lopez <sara@cartology.io>
Date: 2027-06-13T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Quick Redwood walkthrough — curious about latency/cost for embeddings

Hey Vanessa,

We signed up for Redwood yesterday (self-serve) and poked around the API. Looks promising — we're evaluating options for in-product semantic search and chat assistance. Two quick asks before we book a demo:

- Can Redwood handle a steady steady-state of ~2M embedding requests / month (mostly small texts, avg tokens ~30)?
- Typical P95 latency for embed calls on hosted tier?
- Any recommended quantization / batching approach for reducing cost without losing recall?

Also connecting Sara (product) — she owns search. Would love a short walkthrough next week to see the console, and any guidance on pilot sizing.

Thanks —
Alex
Alex Kim
Head of Product
Cartology
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alex Kim <alex.kim@cartology.io>
Cc: Sara Lopez <sara@cartology.io>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-13T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick Redwood walkthrough — curious about latency/cost for embeddings

Hi Alex — great to meet you (and hi Sara). I can definitely help with that — short answers up front, then a few quick clarifying questions so we tailor the walkthrough.

Short answers:
- 2M/month embeddings is well within the hosted platform; we see many customers in the 1–10M/month range.
- P95: for small texts (~30 tokens) on hosted we typically observe P95 ~70–150ms depending on model family (smaller open models are faster; production L2 models higher).
- Cost controls: start with batching (we default to micro-batching on the service) + a 16-bit quantized model variant for embeddings — good tradeoff for recall.

To make the demo useful, could you confirm:
1) Primary use case: vector search for product catalog, or chat/assist? Any retrieval + rerank step?
2) Traffic shape: is 2M/month evenly distributed or do you have bursts/day? If bursts, what peak TPS or requests/min?
3) Pilot timeline: are you aiming to pilot in 2–4 weeks, or a longer 2–3 month evaluation?
4) Do you need SSO / enterprise compliance for the pilot?

I attached a short pre-demo checklist (redwood-pre-demo-checklist.pdf) that explains what we typically review in a 25–30 minute walkthrough.

If you prefer, Ben (cc'd) can coordinate a few availability windows once you share the timeline. Proposed format: 20m product + 10m ops (throughput/cost).

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise SDR, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Kim <alex.kim@cartology.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Lopez <sara@cartology.io>
Date: 2027-06-13T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick Redwood walkthrough — curious about latency/cost for embeddings

Thanks Vanessa — answers inline below and attached a tiny traffic sample (sample_traffic_snapshot.csv).

1) Use case: primary is vector search over product descriptions (search) + a small chat overlay for logged-in users. We'll do a simple rerank step in our app server.
2) Traffic shape: about 70% steady queries; 30% concentrated during marketing emails and holiday pushes. Peak we expect ~15–20 reqs/sec for embeds during bursts.
3) Timeline: pilot goal is 3–6 weeks — proof-of-concept for search recall and cost numbers.
4) No SSO required for the pilot — vendor/contracting comes later.

Also quick question: is there a recommended embedding model you prefer for product text? We care more about recall than speed, but cost is a factor.

Appreciate the checklist — will review it before the demo.

—Alex

Attachment: sample_traffic_snapshot.csv (csv, 2 KB)

Subject: Scheduling: Redwood quick walkthrough for Cartology (20m)

Hi Alex + Sara — Ben here from Redwood ops. Thanks for the details — that traffic shape is straightforward for a 3–6 week pilot. Vanessa recommended a short session focused on:

- Console walkthrough: model catalog, embeddings metrics, billing/usage view (10m)
- Pilot sizing: expected cost with batching/quantization + concurrency knobs (8m)
- Next steps & pilot checklist (2m)

Two options if either works for you:
1) Tuesday 6/16 11:00–11:20 AM PT
2) Wednesday 6/17 3:30–3:50 PM PT

Or use our quick scheduler: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min (pick any 20–30m slot and we'll adjust). Once you pick a time I'll send a calendar invite with a short agenda and a link to a shared doc for the pilot plan.

One last note — for embeddings we generally recommend the rdx-embed-compact model for a cost/recall baseline; if recall proves insufficient we can run a short eval on a larger model family. We'll walk you through that evaluation during the session.

Cheers,
